alt: Wetland habitat and boardwalks at Saiwa Swamp National Park
name: Saiwa Swamp National Park
description: A peaceful wetland sanctuary known for the rare sitatunga antelope, birds and boardwalks.
studentTips: Carry binoculars if available and confirm park entry fees before visiting.

alt: Mountain scenery and forested slopes of Mount Elgon National Park
name: Mount Elgon National Park
description: A mountain wilderness with forests, caves, waterfalls and dramatic highland scenery.
bestTime: A dry spell with suitable hiking conditions
duration: Half a day to a full day
studentTips: Wear sturdy shoes, carry water and check road conditions and park access.

alt: Dense tropical rainforest and green forest trails in Kakamega Forest
name: Kakamega Forest Reserve
description: A tropical rainforest with rich birdlife, butterflies, monkeys and forest trails.
bestTime: Check rainfall and trail conditions before visiting
duration: Half a day to a full day
studentTips: Use a guide where appropriate and wear comfortable shoes suitable for forest trails.

alt: Towering cliffs and volcanic rock formations at Hell's Gate National Park
name: Hell's Gate National Park
description: A dramatic landscape of cliffs, gorges and volcanic rock formations.
duration: Half a day to a full day
studentTips: Check gorge access and safety notices; bicycle hire and other activities may cost extra.

alt: Mature trees and green walking paths at Nairobi Arboretum
name: Nairobi Arboretum
description: A green urban space with tree collections, walking paths and places to relax outdoors.
studentTips: Check current entry charges and park rules before your visit.

alt: Lush greenery and walking trails inside Karura Forest
name: Karura Forest
description: An urban forest with walking and cycling trails, waterfalls and quiet natural scenery.
studentTips: Confirm the current entrance fee and any bicycle-hire charges.

alt: Rolling green hills and panoramic countryside views at Ngong Hills
name: Ngong Hills
description: A series of green hills offering panoramic views of the Rift Valley and surrounding countryside.
bestTime: Clear weather and an early start
studentTips: Go with companions, carry water and check the current access and safety guidance.

alt: Lake Baringo surrounded by the dry hills of Kenya's Rift Valley
name: Kitale Nature Conservancy
description: A local nature destination for exploring greenery, observing wildlife and enjoying a peaceful outdoor visit.
studentTips: Contact the conservancy to confirm access, available activities and current charges.

alt: Scenic crater lake and surrounding landscape at Simbi Nyaima
name: Simbi Nyaima
description: A volcanic crater lake associated with local folklore and known for its distinctive landscape and birdlife.
bestTime: Clear weather for viewing and photography
studentTips: Confirm access arrangements and any community or site charges before travelling.

alt: Freshwater lake, shoreline and surrounding scenery at Lake Naivasha
name: Lake Naivasha
description: A freshwater lake surrounded by scenic landscapes and known for its birdlife and hippos.

alt: White sandy shoreline and turquoise ocean waters at Diani Beach
name: Diani Beach
description: A beautiful stretch of beach with clear waters and a relaxed atmosphere.
bestTime: A dry spell with good visibility
studentTips: Check weather conditions, carry water and sun protection, and compare water-sport prices before booking.

alt: Forested mountain slopes and scenic landscapes at Ol Donyo Sabuk National Park
name: Ol Donyo Sabuk National Park
description: A forested mountain destination offering hiking opportunities and views of the surrounding plains.
bestTime: A dry spell with good visibility
studentTips: Start early and bring water, sturdy shoes and sun protection.

alt: Mountain scenery and forest trails at Ol Donyo Sabuk National Park
name: Ol Donyo Sabuk National Park
description: A forested mountain destination offering hiking opportunities and views of the surrounding plains.
bestTime: Clear weather and suitable trail conditions
duration: Half a day to a full day
studentTips: Arrange return transport and confirm park entry and hiking conditions.
location: Ol Donyo Sabuk, near Thika, Kenya

alt: Trees and landscaped outdoor scenery in Nairobi
name: Nairobi National Museum
description: A museum featuring Kenyan history, culture, art and natural-history exhibits.
studentTips: Ask about student rates and carry valid identification if required.

alt: Lake Elementaita and its scenic Rift Valley surroundings
name: Lake Elementaita
description: A scenic Rift Valley lake recognised for birdlife and striking views of the surrounding landscape.
studentTips: Check whether your chosen viewpoint is inside a managed sanctuary with its own entry fee.

alt: Lush indigenous forest and natural scenery at Ngare Ndare Forest
name: Ngare Ndare Forest
description: A beautiful indigenous forest near Mount Kenya, famous for its turquoise natural pools, waterfalls, forest trails, and elevated canopy walkway.
bestTime: Dry seasons generally offer easier hiking and better trail conditions. Check weather and access conditions before travelling.
duration: Half a day to a full day
studentTips: Travel with friends to share transport costs. Confirm current entry fees, canopy walkway charges, swimming rules, and opening hours before visiting. Carry drinking water and suitable walking shoes.

alt: Freshwater Lake Baringo surrounded by the Rift Valley landscape
name: Lake Baringo
description: A freshwater lake known for bird diversity, scenic surroundings and optional guided experiences.
bestTime: Check local weather and tour availability
duration: Half a day to a full day
studentTips: Ask about guide and boat charges before booking activities.

alt: Open savannah grasslands and wildlife habitat in the Maasai Mara
name: Maasai Mara National Reserve
description: A renowned national reserve known for its abundant wildlife, including the Big Five and the Great Migration.
bestTime: Check local weather and tour availability
duration: Half a day to a full day
studentTips: Compare safari package prices and confirm current reserve entry fees, vehicle charges, and transport costs before visiting.

alt: Savannah grasslands and wildlife habitat in Ruma National Park
name: Ruma National Park
description: A scenic national park in the Lambwe Valley, known for its rare roan antelope, Rothschild's giraffe, diverse birdlife, and beautiful savannah landscapes.
bestTime: Dry seasons generally offer better wildlife viewing and road conditions. Check local conditions before travelling.
duration: Half a day to a full day
studentTips: Travel with friends to share transport costs. Confirm current park entry fees, vehicle charges, and road conditions with Kenya Wildlife Service before visiting.
location: Lambwe Valley, Homa Bay County, Kenya
